diagnostics.message: Invocation of function-typed value 'g' (type 'Func<i32>') is an error under effect enforcement: function-typed values carry no effect contract, so the call cannot be charged. Wrap the call in §CSHARP interop (surfaced as an assumption via Calor0419) or compile with --permissive-effects (an explicit waiver).
